pages.text: SYN Market Wire weekly wrap for the week ending 2026-03-27. The SSE All-Share Index closed the week ending 2026-03-27 at 1,907.90 points. The 91-day Treasury bill auction that week cleared at 7.93 percent. Weekly turnover on the exchange was SYN Sh 867 million. The top gainer of the week was Msitu Logistics (SYN).

Market participants said the move reflected steady demand from retail and institutional investors. The development follows a year in which small investors have shown growing interest in formal products. Trading volumes were broadly in line with the previous month, according to exchange data.
